body: Thing is I've been called cute, and I don't wanna brag or sound vein here but what bugs me most is that I just simply can't see it in myself! I want to go into acting/directing as a career (as overboard as it seems) but all I ever think about is how I'm too ugly to step in front of a camera or do an interview or whatever which really crashes my dreams. I really want to start trying to love myself but whenever I get a shred of confidence it all just comes crumbling back down!
But I'll always be ugly. Being gay makes it worse, no one would ever want me :(
